job.title: Auto Loan Collections Associate
job.description:
Company Description:

We are One Sutherland — a global team where everyone is working together to create great breakthrough solutions. Our workforce has thrived in an environment of diversity of thought, experience and background. We celebrate our diversity and embrace it whole-heartedly. Sutherland is an equal opportunity employer. We promote a positive work environment by conducting ourselves professionally and helping each other achieve our goal of One Sutherland Team, Playing to Win.

Sutherland was founded 35 years ago (1986). Since then, we have become a leading global provider of business process and technology management services offering an integrated portfolio of analytics-driven back office and customer-facing solutions that support the entire customer life cycle.

Job Description:

Are you an excellent verbal and written communicator, and a great listener? Do you thrive on a team that's focused on finding the best solutions for customers? Can you remain kind and supportive when customers share their concerns about their loan? Do you have prior collections, sales or customer service experience?

We are seeking a motivated and passionate Auto Loan Collections Advisor to join us! If you are looking to build a fulfilling career, and the description above resonates with you, we want to work with you!

Essential Duties in this role:

  • Associates handle inbound or outbound calls with existing customers. Associates should educate customers on account status, attempting to solve customer problems and/or attempting to secure a payment or make payment arrangements. The goal is to help our customers build and retain a strong credit standing and maintain a customer for life.
  • Provide excellent customer service to customers who need assistance in meeting their contract obligations due to unexpected financial obligations.
  • Contact or attempt contact with customers who are delinquent.
  • Overcome objections that customers have about making payments toward their account and help them to understand their account(s) and responsibilities.
  • Maintain positive working relationships with the Loan Servicing team. 
  • Meet or exceed production goals 
  • Performs other related duties as assigned

What Kind of Associates Are We Looking for?

  • Agile in a fast-past environment.
  • You embody excellent customer service.
  • Team oriented and people-oriented.
  • Critical thinker and quick learner.
  • Has good active listening skills.
  • Professional and persuasive communication and negotiation skills
  • Passionate and goal-oriented
  • Positive emotional resilience and emotional intelligence.
  • Must be self-motivated with strong decision-making and problem solving abilities
  • Flexible and committed to overall goals.

Qualifications:

Our most successful candidates will have: - 

  • Must be 18 years and older.
  • A minimum of 3-4 CXC/GCE subjects inclusive of English Language, or a U.S. high school diploma or GED. We require all candidates to have a minimum of 3 subjects inclusive of English (CXC/CSEC, City & Guilds. I, II, III; GCE A, B, C; SSC 4, 5; JSCE Pass; NCTVET Level 1, 2, 3; and CCSLC Competence & Mastery).
  • Must have a valid (not expired) government issued ID, TRN and NIS card.
  • Must have flexible availability to work any day and any assigned shift weekly.(Weekends and Public Holidays).
  • Must be able to train and / or work onsite.
  • Demonstrated ability to perform at a high level, to support our high volume of inbound calls.
  • Experience in customer service is an asset and preferred.
  • Good systematic problem solving ability , using sound business judgment, and following through on commitments to customers.
  • The ability to quickly and accurately identify and assess individual customer needs and take appropriate action steps to satisfy those needs.
  • Excellent attention to detail.
  • See through the eyes of the customer.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills; able to translate Customer communication rapidly and effectively on live voice or chat interactions. proficient reading skills required.
  • The ability to project patience, empathy, caring, and sincerity in written words or voice tone, depending on channel.
  • Ability to effectively organize, prioritize, multi-task and manage time.
  • Multi-tasking skills, showcased through the use of several applications; experience working with CRM applications preferred.
  • Basic PC keyboarding skills; basic Microsoft Office (Outlook, Word, Excel) experience required.

Additional Information:

Our employees enjoy:

  • Discounts for several corporate and retail partners for services and products once Sutherland ID is presented.

job.title: Operations - Real-Time Queue Analyst
job.description:
Company Description:

About Sutherland

Artificial Intelligence. Automation. Cloud engineering. Advanced analytics. For business leaders, these are key factors of success. For us, they’re our core expertise.

We work with global iconic brands. We bring them a unique value proposition through market-leading technologies and business process excellence. At the heart of it all is Digital Engineering - the foundation that powers rapid innovation and scalable business transformation.

We've created 363 unique and independent inventions, 250 of which are AI-based and rolled up under several patent grants in critical technologies. Leveraging our advanced products and platforms, we drive digital transformation at scale, optimize critical business operations, reinvent experiences, and pioneer new solutions, all provided through a seamless "as-a-service" model.

For each company, we provide new keys for their businesses, the people they work with, and the customers they serve. With proven strategies and agile execution, we don't just enable change - we engineer digital outcomes.

Sutherland
Digital Outcomes.

Job Description:

Objective: To monitor, analyze, and manage interaction volumes (calls, chats, emails) and agent availability in real-time. The Real-Time Analyst takes immediate action and coordinates with Operations to ensure Service Level Agreement (SLA) compliance, optimize agent occupancy, and drive schedule adherence, strictly following contact center efficiency and COPC standards.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Intraday Monitoring: Continuously monitor real-time dashboards to track inbound contact volumes, Average Handle Time (AHT), and Service Levels against forecasted trends.
  • Adherence & Shrinkage Management: Track agent status in real-time (AUX codes) to ensure strict compliance with schedules, breaks, and training sessions. Immediately identify and report operational deviations to minimize unproductive shrinkage.
  • Skill & Routing Adjustments: Modify agent skilling within routing platforms to mitigate bottlenecks in critical queues or absorb unexpected spikes in traffic across all channels.
  • Operational Coordination: Act as the primary liaison between the Workforce Management (WFM) team and Operations (Supervisors/Coordinators). Communicate early warnings, escalate critical issues, and recommend action plans during operational contingencies.
  • Technology & AI Integration: Oversee alerts generated by automation tools or AI-driven predictive models implemented within the contact center to ensure early detection of traffic anomalies and safeguard routing efficiency.
  • Intraday Reporting: Generate detailed End-of-Day (EOD) reports highlighting variances between planned and actual metrics, documenting the events that impacted KPIs and the corrective actions taken.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs):

  • Service Level (SLA): Meet or exceed interval target goals.
  • Abandon Rate: Maintain lost interactions below the target threshold.
  • Schedule Adherence: Ensure actual time logged matches planned time.
  • Occupancy: Optimize agent productive time without causing burnout.

 

Qualifications:

Requirements & Qualifications:

Hard Skills:

  • Minimum 1-2 years of proven experience in Workforce Management (WFM), Real-Time Analyst (RTA), Traffic Control, or Intraday Monitoring roles within a BPO/Contact Center environment.
  • Hands-on experience with industry-leading ACD platforms and WFM tools (e.g., Genesys, NICE, Verint, or similar).
  • Experience managing and monitoring Chat platforms like Omnichannel Chat, Oracle Right now, etc workflows, controlling agent concurrency and real-time digital interaction distribution.
  • Advanced proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets for rapid data extraction, cross-referencing, and operational data analysis.
  • Strong understanding of standard contact center efficiency metrics (SLA, Shrinkage, Adherence, Occupancy, AHT) and mathematical models such as Erlang C.

Soft Skills:

  • Decision-Making Under Pressure: Ability to quickly and logically execute contingency plans (e.g., skill adjustments, overflow activation) during volume spikes or system outages.
  • Assertive Communication & Influence: Strong ability to deliver clear instructions and escalate issues professionally to Operations leaders, driving adherence corrections without direct hierarchical authority over the agents.
  • Systemic Thinking: Capacity to connect tactical interval management with broader organizational goals related to profitability, efficiency, and customer experience.

 

Additional Information:

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

job.title: Data Analyst
job.description:
Company Description:

Artificial Intelligence. Automation. Cloud Engineering. Advanced Analytics.
For Enterprises, these are key factors of success. For us, they're our core expertise.

We work with global iconic brands. We bring them a unique value proposition through market-leading technologies and business process excellence. At the heart of it all is Digital Engineering - the foundation that powers rapid innovation and scalable business transformation.

We've created 363 unique and independent inventions, 250 of which are AI-based and rolled up under several patent grants in critical technologies. Leveraging our advanced products and platforms, we drive digital transformation at scale, optimize critical business operations, reinvent experiences, and pioneer new solutions, all provided through a seamless "as-a-service" model.

For each company, we provide new keys for their businesses, the people they work with, and the customers they serve. With proven strategies and agile execution, we don't just enable change - we engineer digital outcomes.
Sutherland
Digital Outcomes.

 

Job Description:

Data Engineering & Fabric Development

  • Design and develop data pipelines using Microsoft Fabric Data Factory.
  • Create and maintain Lakehouse and Warehouse solutions within Microsoft Fabric.
  • Implement and manage Bronze, Silver, and Gold Layer architectures.
  • Develop scalable ETL/ELT pipelines for ingesting and transforming data from multiple sources.
  • Monitor pipeline performance and troubleshoot data quality issues.

Data Modeling

  • Design and develop Fact Tables and Dimension Tables following dimensional modeling principles.
  • Create and maintain Star Schema and Snowflake Schema data models.
  • Define surrogate keys, business keys, and Slowly Changing Dimensions (SCD) where required.
  • Optimize data models for reporting and analytics performance.

SQL Development

  • Write complex SQL queries for data extraction, transformation, and validation.
  • Build views, stored procedures, and reusable query frameworks.
  • Perform query optimization and performance tuning.

Python Development

  • Develop Python-based data transformation and validation scripts.
  • Use libraries such as:
    • Pandas
    • NumPy
    • PySpark
    • Requests
  • Automate data quality checks and reconciliation processes.

Analytics & Reporting

  • Partner with business stakeholders to gather reporting and analytics requirements.
  • Develop datasets optimized for Power BI reporting.
  • Support creation of KPIs, metrics, and business data definitions.
  • Ensure data governance and consistency across analytical solutions.

Qualifications:

Our most successful candidates will have:

  • 3-7 years of experience in Data Analytics, Data Engineering, or Business Intelligence.
  • Minimum 2 years of hands-on experience with Microsoft Fabric or Azure-based analytics platforms.
  • Proven experience building:
    • Fact Tables
    • Dimension Tables
    • Data Pipelines
    • Power BI datasets

 

  • Experience with Microsoft Azure Data Services.
  • Experience with Delta Tables and Apache Spark.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD and Git-based development.
  • Understanding of data governance and lineage concepts.
  • Microsoft Fabric Certification preferred:
    • DP-600
    • DP-700

job.title: Sr. Mortgage Underwriter- West Coast or west coast hours preferred
job.description:
Company Description:

Sutherland Mortgage Services Inc. is a premier nationwide provider of end to end mortgage solutions including originations, underwriting, processing, closing, post-closing and loan servicing support. With over 30 years of experience we have developed an integrated BPO platform. Sutherland has built mutually beneficial relationships with some of the world’s most recognized companies. Sutherland Mortgage Services’ Team Players work throughout the country with our state-of-the-art Work at Home (WAH) Program. We offer an unmatched ability to deliver the highest value and greatest returns to our customers. We are a collaborative, considerate and friendly team. Having a diverse, inclusive and respectful workplace is important to us and we support your career development, internal mobility and work-life balance.

Job Description:

We are now hiring a Mortgage Underwriter to work from home with Sutherland equipment provided. We are seeking top notch, attentive, and goal-oriented underwriters who have experience in retail or correspondent frontline mortgage underwriting. If you are looking to build a fulfilling career and are confident you have the skills and experience to help us succeed, we want to work with you!

What you will be doing?

- Decision incoming applications consistent with internal, client and investor policies.

- Analyze employment profile, credit strength, property characteristics, and all other information pertinent to the credit decision on each mortgage application.

- Prioritize deals in Workflow queue in order to minimize turnaround time.

- Select required conditions on each deal to be satisfied prior to funding.

- Using the underwriting system, input: selected conditions, credit information, property details, and borrower information.

- Verify accuracy of supporting employment, down payment, appraisal, and financial documentation received.

- Review documentation for compliance with internal and regulatory guidelines.

- Correspond with processors to attain outstanding documentation needed to complete requirements as stipulated on the commitment.

 

Qualifications:

- 5+ years prior Mortgage Underwriting experience preferred.

- Strong communication skills, verbal and written

- Strong analytical skills

- Demonstrated ability to resolve complicated issues as they arise

- Proven organizational skills and demonstrated ability to prioritize and multi-task

- Prior AUS experience required

- Prior experience with FNMA/FHLMC guidelines required

- Encompass/Empower experience a plus

job.title: Disability and Leave Services Associate - Contract Opportunity
job.description:
Company Description:

About Sutherland

We are  One Sutherland  — a global team where everyone is working together to create great breakthrough solutions. Our workforce has thrived in an environment of diversity of thought, experience and background. We celebrate our diversity and embrace it whole-heartedly. Sutherland is an equal opportunity employer. We promote a positive work environment by conducting ourselves professionally and helping each other achieve our goal of One Sutherland Team, Playing to Win.

Sutherland was founded 35 years ago (1986). Since then, we have become a leading global provider of business process and technology management services offering an integrated portfolio of analytics-driven back office and customer-facing solutions that support the entire customer life cycle.

Artificial Intelligence. Automation. Cloud engineering. Advanced analytics. For business leaders, these are key factors of success. For us, they’re our core expertise.
We work with iconic brands worldwide. We bring them a unique value proposition through market-leading technology and business process excellence.

We’ve created over 200 unique inventions under several patents across AI and other critical technologies. Leveraging our advanced products and platforms, we drive digital transformation, optimize critical business operations, reinvent experiences, and pioneer new solutions, all provided through a seamless “as a service” model.

For each company, we provide new keys for their businesses, the people they work with, and the customers they serve. We tailor proven and rapid formulas, to fit their unique DNA. We bring together human expertise and artificial intelligence to develop digital chemistry. This unlocks new possibilities, transformative outcomes and enduring relationships.

Sutherland
Unlocking digital performance. Delivering measurable results.

Job Description:

The DLS associate is an HR representative that takes care of related contacts from a Fortune 500 company's employees across the US. Associates will work one-on-one with employees while maintaining successful partnerships with HR Business Partners. This Disability and Leave Services (DLS) team has a best-in-class case management program to deliver leave of absence, disability and accommodation services to employees across the U.S. The Case Specialist will be an individual contributor and provides support for Case management for leave of absence and disability life events. They are highly skilled in case review, document validation and correspondence handling.

Essential Responsibilities - 

  • Serve as a point of contact for assigned employees to provide holistic case management services, including reviewing documentation to adjudicate leaves in compliance with the corresponding leave plans, federal and state laws and benefit plans as defined by our clients.
  • Leverage duration guidelines, best practice tools and resources to support oversight of a leave event as appropriate
  • Critically assess and adjust the case management plan to an employee’s changing needs
  • Address and respond to sensitive situations.
  • Troubleshoot issues and seek to remove barriers before, during, or after a leave event
  • Respond to employee impacting issues that may arise during the leave event and ensure the right communication occurs
  • Identify and solve problems that may arise, sometimes with limited information
  • Facilitate a smooth return to work and ramp-back plan for employees returning to the workplace
  • Ensure compliance with standard work, federal/state regulations, and company policy
  • Maintain system records to ensure accurate and timely information/documentation .
  • Other duties as assigned
  • In this role you will master your research skills and ability to resolve HR issues coming in via the DLS phone system while using our case management system to document and track every call with high level of accuracy. Moreover, you will encourage self-service tools available for all employees.
  • Become knowledgable through research and training about the governing labor laws (each state has different labor laws)
  • As a member of the HR organization, you will handle confidential and sensitive information, as well as demonstrate strong integrity and ethical behaviors. You will use your strong analytical and critical-thinking skills to bring about continuous improvement daily; put your exceptional customer service, communication, organizational skills, superior attention to detail and ability to prioritize to work in a fast-paced, rapidly changing HR environment.

Qualifications:

Our most successful candidates will have: - 

  • Must be at least 18 years or older.
  • We require all candidates to have a minimum of 3 subjects inclusive of English (CXC/CSEC, City & Guilds. I, II, III; GCE A, B, C; SSC 4, 5; JSCE Pass; NCTVET Level 1, 2, 3; and CCSLC Competence & Mastery) OR or a U.S. high school diploma or GED. 
  • Must have flexible availability to work any day and any assigned shift weekly.(Weekends and Public Holidays).
  • Must be flexible to work and train on site or work from home as needed by the business.
  • Must successfully pass English Language written assessments.
  • Consistency in performance and an "I can and will win attitude".
  • Demonstrated ability to perform at a high level, to support our high volume of inbound calls.
  • Experience in customer service is an asset and preferred.
  • Good systematic problem solving ability , using sound business judgment, and following through on commitments to customers.
  • The ability to quickly and accurately identify and assess individual customer needs and take appropriate action steps to satisfy those needs.
  • Excellent attention to detail.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills; able to translate Customer communication rapidly and effectively on live voice or chat interactions. proficient reading skills required.
  • The ability to project patience, empathy, caring, and sincerity in written words or voice tone, depending on channel.
  • Ability to effectively organize, prioritize, multi-task and manage time.
  • Multi-tasking skills, showcased through the use of several applications; experience working with CRM applications preferred.
  • Basic PC keyboarding skills; basic Microsoft Office (Outlook, Word, Excel) experience required.
  • Must have basic computer skills with the ability to navigate and manipulate a computer system.
  • Must be very tech savvy with strong abilities in handling troubleshooting techniques and resolving technical issues.
  • Inspire confidence and positively influence the behaviour, actions, and thoughts of others.
  • No commitments that will impact your ability to commit to work for the next 18 – 24 months

Additional Information:

Our employees enjoy:

  • Competitive compensation packages inclusive of base pay, incentives, over-time and shift differentials for certain shifts.
  • Annual merit increase based on performance.
  • Paid Training.
  • Discounts for several corporate and retail partners for services and products once Sutherland ID is presented.
  • Excellent training and supervisory support - to help you feel comfortable servicing our customers.
  • Competitive Salary with attractive and attainable PBI structure.
  • Paid vacation and sick leave annually.
  • Exceptional Health and Life Insurance Plan
  • Lunch benefits and subsidy.
  • Onsite lunch concessionaire at reduced rates.
  • Transportation/ Shuttle Services - Free transportation home for shifts that end after 9:00 pm and pick-ups for shifts that begin before 6am
  • Free On-site medical suite with nurse and medical doctor.
  • Daily Refuel Plan - Robust and dynamic schedule of activities to keep employees energized both at home and in the office.
  • Paid referral program
  • Career development & growth opportunities for advancement.
  • Excellent Reward and recognition programs.

Sutherland is seeking a dedicated SME to support a new program launching in Alexandria! The SME is the first line of process and productivity support for agents. If you're ready for the next step in your career, can speak SPANISH or ITALIAN  + English, we want to hear from you!

  • MUST speak SPANISH or ITALIAN fluently + B2 English (please note on CV)
  • Experience as an SME supporting a sales program will be highly desirable
  • Able to work onsite in Alexandria 
  • Open availability

Job Description:

The New Hire Compliance Manager is responsible for overseeing, executing, and auditing the continuous identity and physical location verification processes across the remote employee life cycle. Grounded in the corporate Identity & Location Verification SOP, this role ensures strict adherence to pre-hire validation, onboarding checks, continuous monitoring using advanced technology (Sentinel Vision, Zscaler, Webex Console, and Yubikey biometric hardware tokens), exception management, and client incident reporting.

Key Responsibilities & Duties

Lifecycle Identity & Location Assurance

  • Pre-Hire & Onboarding Audit: Oversee multi-point identity validation during recruitment (video interview image capture, SHL behavioral assessment photo capture, and Webex-based I-9 document verification via Sterling Portal).
  • Day 1 New Hire Orientation (NHO): Monitor individual breakout identity checks, ensure camera visual verification matches stored I-9 records, and oversee Webex Admin Console IP and geographic location checks.
  • Training-Stage Verification Governance: Audit daily training identity checks to ensure 100% trainee camera verification against enrolled reference photos, and oversee mandatory go-live identity gate audits.
  • Quarterly & Event-Driven Revalidation: Direct 100% coverage quarterly identity validation across active operations teams, ensuring timestamped visual ID card checks, and photo captures are logged.

Continuous Technology & Hardware Monitoring

  • Sentinel Vision Monitoring Oversight: Manage operational compliance for the Sentinel Vision (Lite) continuous workstation monitoring system, tracking alerts for loss of face match, multi-person frame detection, and screen recording activity.
  • Physical & Hardware Audits: Enforce physical location checklist audits, including PC/monitor asset tag verification, wall outlet types, ISP modem validation, travel router/VPN checks, and phone verification.
  • Alternative Token Governance: Oversee the biometric Yubikey opt-out program for clients prohibiting Sentinel deployment, ensuring in-person/on-camera enrollment standards.

Exception Management & Incident Escalation

  • Incident Response & Investigation: Act as the primary compliance point of contact when identity or location discrepancies occur. Immediately pause training/system access, perform trigger escalation and create iSmart IT Incident (INC) tickets for Information Security.
  • Client & Executive Notification: Lead rapid escalation protocols, ensuring immediate notification to Account Teams for confirmed or suspected impersonation cases.
  • Cross-Functional Coordination: Collaborate with InfoSec, IT/Logistics, Asset Recovery, Talent Acquisition, Service Delivery, and HR to resolve access/location violations within defined SLAs (e.g., 24-hour escalation targets).

Compliance Governance, Data Security & Reporting

  • Record & Evidence Management: Ensure all timestamped evidence records, photo captures, and audit trails are securely maintained in eDMS (and interim Smartsheet logs) in compliance with 90-day retention policies.
  • Performance & Risk Reporting: Consolidate findings across all identity-verification checkpoints into monthly Performance & Risk Reports for executive review.
  • Threat Intelligence Reviews: Participate in threat-intelligence reviews to evaluate emerging remote impersonation risks and recommend control enhancements.

Qualifications:

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in business administration, Human Resources, Criminal Justice, Information Security, Compliance, or related field.
  • Minimum of 1 to 3 years of experience in Talent Management, Recruitment, or HR Operations, with demonstrated leadership in US HR program delivery.
  • Soft Skills: Exceptional attention to detail, strong analytical and investigative skills, firm adherence to ethical standards ability to manage sensitive HR data with integrity. Proficiency in MS Office tools and data privacy guidelines, and strong executive communication skills.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Audit Coverage: 100% compliance rate on mandatory training stage and quarterly operational identity checks.
  • SLA Adherence: 100% compliance with defined review SLAs for Sentinel alerts and iSmart incident escalations.
  • Data Security & Integrity: Zero unauthorized data retention or privacy breaches across identity records.
  • Client Trust: Rapid turnaround and complete documentation on all client-notified impersonation inquiries.

Additional Information:

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Company Description:

Sutherland’s Research—covering Equity Research, Credit Research, Investment Banking, and Business Research—Markets Insights, and Innovation division drives high-impact programs that address clients’ complex business and technology challenges. Sutherland Research and MII have made significant investments in building technology-led solutions that transform how data, research, and actionable insights are delivered for strategic and investment decision-making. 

Job Description:

As part of the Sutherland Research and MII technology team, the Senior Data Engineer will design, develop, and maintain scalable data platforms that support financial research, analytics, automation and artificial intelligence solutions.

The individual will work closely with domain specialists and client stakeholders to convert data from structured and semi-structured sources into reliable, governed, and analytically usable datasets. The role provides an opportunity to work on modern cloud data platforms (Azure/AWS/GCP), large-scale data transformation programs, financial datasets, AI-enabled applications and enterprise-grade data products.

The Senior Data Engineer will be expected to provide technical leadership, independently manage data-engineering workstreams, mentor team members and ensure that solutions meet enterprise requirements for scalability, security, performance, governance and operational resilience.

 

Job responsibilities

  • Lead enterprise data platforms across 3–5 large-scale programs end-to-end.
  • Architect data lakes, warehouses, lakehouses, and analytics products at scale.
  • Define reusable frameworks for ingestion, transformation, governance, and observability.
  • Mentor 5-10 member engineering teams across delivery, reviews, and issue resolution.

Qualifications:

To succeed in this position, the candidate must have: 

  • 10+ years in data engineering, architecture, migrations, or integration.
  • Delivered 5+ enterprise data projects across cloud, lakehouse, or analytics platforms.
  • Strong expertise in Python, SQL, Spark, cloud, orchestration, and modelling.
  • Proven leadership in governance, security, CI/CD, monitoring, and stakeholder management.
  • Knowledge of finance, valuation, and investment research will be a plus.

Job Description:

Position Purpose

Drives the daily operational performance and real-time execution of the helpdesk team. This role balances workforce monitoring, service level compliance, and active agent coaching to foster a high-performance service environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Queue & Service Level Management: Actively monitor real-time call queues, abandon rates, and ticket backlogs to dynamically shift resources and secure daily SLA targets.
  • Performance Coaching: Conduct structured weekly call monitoring audits and monthly performance feedback sessions for L1 and L2 agents to improve quality and FCR.
  • Operational Escalations: Act as the first formal escalation point for critical operational challenges, vendor disconnects, or highly dissatisfied employees.
  • Quality Assurance: Partner with the Quality Analyst to review team performance metrics, identify training gaps, and implement targeted remediation plans.
  • Team Engagement: Manage front-line team culture, driving initiatives to boost employee engagement, prevent burnout, and reduce team attrition.

Experience in Years

  • Total Experience: 5 to 7 years of professional experience in customer management/operations.
  • Domain-Specific Experience: Minimum 2 years of direct people management or supervisory experience leading a team within a voice-capable contact centre or an HR Shared Services hub.

Ideal Candidate Experience & Profile

  • People Developer: The ideal candidate is an inspiring front-line captain who has successfully managed groups of 10–15 agents, focusing heavily on operational metrics without losing sight of human morale.
  • Metric-Driven Floor Manager: They are hyper-aware of real-time dashboards. They know exactly when a spike in call volume requires altering break schedules or pulling an agent out of an offline task.
  • Constructive Coach: They have mastered the art of delivering direct, actionable performance feedback that motivates underperforming agents rather than discouraging them.
  • Process Fixer: They don't just patch problems; they proactively identify when a high volume of L1 transfers means the team needs an updated SOP or a refresher training session.

Required Skills & Qualifications

  • Operational Literacy: Solid understanding of contact center dynamics and core metrics (e.g., SLA, Occupancy, Shrinkage, CSAT, ASA).

job.title: Back Office - Service Dispatch & Case Management Specialist
job.description:
Descripción de la empresa:

We are One Sutherland — a global team where everyone is working together to create great breakthrough solutions. Our workforce has thrived in an environment of diversity of thought, experience and background. We celebrate our diversity and embrace it whole-heartedly. Sutherland is an equal opportunity employer. We promote a positive work environment by conducting ourselves professionally and helping each other achieve our goal of One Sutherland Team, Playing to Win.

Sutherland was founded 35 years ago (1986). Since then, we have become a leading global provider of business process and technology management services offering an integrated portfolio of analytics-driven back office and customer-facing solutions that support the entire customer life cycle.

Descripción del empleo:

Job Description

The Service Dispatch & Case Management Specialist is a back-office operational role responsible for receiving, validating, processing, tracking, and closing service-related requests, customer cases, Work Orders, parts orders, and operational escalations. The position serves as a central coordination point between Lenovo, Authorized Service Providers (ASPs), internal stakeholders, service partners, retail partners, and customers when required.

This role combines Service Dispatch and Case Management responsibilities to ensure service requests are processed accurately, operational activities progress according to established procedures, and open cases are actively monitored through resolution and closure.

Service Dispatch responsibilities focus on request intake, warranty validation, Work Order creation, parts order processing, shipping guide generation, retail partner support, and service coordination activities.

Case Management responsibilities focus on end-to-end case follow-up, escalation management, parts fulfillment monitoring, backlog control, mailbox management, stakeholder communication, issue resolution coordination, and ensuring compliance with Service Level Agreements (SLAs).

The role does not perform technical troubleshooting but ensures all operational actions required to support service execution and case progression are properly coordinated, documented, and completed.

Key Responsibilities

Service Dispatch Activities

  • Receive, review, validate, and process service requests from operations teams, internal stakeholders, authorized service providers, and retail partners.
  • Monitor assigned mailboxes and manage request intake, assignment, response, and completion.
  • Validate warranty eligibility, service entitlement, request completeness, and required documentation before processing.
  • Create and manage service cases, Work Orders, parts orders, and shipping guides in approved systems.
  • Process dispatch requests and coordinate operational activities required for service execution.
  • Provide status updates, shipment confirmations, Work Order information, and request acknowledgements to authorized stakeholders.
  • Maintain accurate records of dispatch activities, system updates, and service transactions.

Case Management Activities

  • Track and monitor open customer cases, CRU Work Orders, backlog items, and service escalations through resolution and closure.
  • Monitor parts fulfillment activities, back orders, service delays, and operational discrepancies, escalating issues as required.
  • Act as the point of contact for operational escalations received from agents, service partners, ASPs, internal stakeholders, and customers.
  • Coordinate with Service Delivery teams, Parts Distribution teams, Repair Centers, Authorized Service Providers, and other stakeholders to resolve operational blockers.
  • Prioritize activities based on SLA risk, customer impact, escalation severity, and business urgency.
  • Follow up on pending actions and aging cases until completion or formal handoff.
  • Prepare and maintain accurate case documentation, escalation summaries, customer communications, and operational updates.
  • Ensure all requests, cases, and Work Orders are properly documented, updated, and closed in accordance with operational procedures and audit requirements.

Shared Responsibilities

  • Ensure compliance with Lenovo procedures, documentation requirements, escalation guidelines, service standards, and operational governance controls.
  • Identify process gaps, recurring issues, data inconsistencies, and operational risks and escalate accordingly.
  • Support continuous improvement initiatives through accurate documentation, reporting, and feedback.
  • Maintain data integrity, audit readiness, and operational traceability across all assigned activities.

Requisitos:

ualifications

Education

  • High School Diploma or equivalent required.
  • Technical, vocational, or college-level studies in Business Administration, Customer Service, Logistics, Operations, Supply Chain, Information Technology, or related fields preferred.

Experience

  • Minimum 1-2 years of experience in case management, service operations, dispatch coordination, customer service operations, service desk support, logistics support, back-office operations, or related operational roles.
  • Experience managing service requests, cases, Work Orders, dispatch activities, escalation workflows, or administrative processes.
  • Experience working within SLA-driven service environments preferred.
  • Experience supporting retail partners, authorized service providers, field service organizations, or customer service operations preferred.

Knowledge & Skills

  • Strong understanding of service operations, case management, dispatch coordination, escalation management, and workload prioritization.
  • Experience using CRM, case management, ticketing, dispatch, logistics, service operations, or order management systems.
  • Familiarity with warranty validation, CRU processes, parts fulfillment, dispatch coordination, repair workflows, and service eligibility requirements.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to coordinate effectively across multiple stakeholder groups.

Responsible for maintaining and auditing site physical security controls, including access control, CCTV, alarms, key management, Server room security, security training, and compliance audits. Investigates security failures, manages remediation and testing, and ensures adherence to physical security policies and standards.  

Key Responsibilities:

  • Access & System Management: Audit and maintain physical access controls, CCTV retention/quality, alarm systems, PIN lifecycles, and key/material tracking.

  • Compliance & Auditing: Conduct regular pre-audits against internal and client security standards (including server room and MDF access), prepare audit files, and support internal/external audit processes.

  • Security Training & Oversight: Support the Security Manager in ensuring personnel, site keyholders, and guarding staff complete required security and safety training on schedule.

  • Incident & Risk Remediation: Investigate physical security failures, oversee system testing, validate SLA response times, and implement corrective actions.

  • Reporting & Administration: Generate daily and monthly security/safety reports, participate in annual policy reviews, and handle confidential information with strict discretion.

Qualifications:

Knowledge and skills (Essential).

  • Must be an intelligent, articulate and persuasive field leader who can serve as an effective Lead.
  • Should understand in general compliance, auditing, and risk management.
  • Must have general working knowledge audits and compliance.
  • Must have a general understanding of information technology and information security as well.

Educational / Professional Qualifications (essentials/desired)

 

  • Bachelor’s degree, preferably in compliance or security field  
    • 2-3 years experience security & safety industries (preferably IT & ITES)
    • General understanding of information technology and information security as well
    • Fluent in English and Excellent in communication skills is a must;
    • Experience of working in a diverse and fast pace multinational environment will be treated as an advantage
    • Advanced and independent user of MS Office applications-mainly Excel
    • Previous security and administrative experience is ideal.
    • Excellent organizational skills  

 

Additional Information:

Competencies

  • Professionalism: Knowledge of security management, combined with background in compliance. Shows persistence when faced with difficult problems or challenges; Remains calm in stressful situations; Takes responsibility for incorporating gender perspectives and ensuring the equal participation of women and men in all areas of work.
  • Teamwork: Works collaboratively with colleagues to achieve organizational goals; Is willing to learn from others; Places team agenda before personal agenda; Supports and acts in accordance with final group decision.
  • Planning and Organizing: Develops clear goals that are consistent with agreed strategies; Identifies priority activities and assignments; Adjusts priorities where necessary; Foresees risks and allows for contingencies when planning; Meets timeline for delivery of products or services
  • Client Orientation: Considers all those to whom services are provided to be “clients” and seeks to see things from clients’ point of view; Keeps Managers informed of progress or setbacks in projects;

job.title: Patient Scheduling Associate - Radiology
job.description:
Company Description:

We are One Sutherland — a global team where everyone is working together to create great breakthrough solutions. Our workforce has thrived in an environment of diversity of thought, experience and background. We celebrate our diversity and embrace it whole-heartedly. Sutherland is an equal opportunity employer. We promote a positive work environment by conducting ourselves professionally and helping each other achieve our goal of One Sutherland Team, Playing to Win.

Sutherland was founded 35 years ago (1986). Since then, we have become a leading global provider of business process and technology management services offering an integrated portfolio of analytics-driven back office and customer-facing solutions that support the entire customer life cycle.

Job Description:

The Patient Scheduling Associate is responsible for scheduling, rescheduling and canceling exams for patients. The Specialty Scheduler is responsible for scheduling complex procedures classified as Specialty Procedures (i.e, LDCT, PET, Nuc Med). This person handles customer service-related requests, communicates preparations, handles call backs, and performs various other clerical tasks.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities 

  • Display excellent communication skills and telephone etiquette.
  • Exceptional written communication skills with a strong focus on quality and attention to detail.
  • Place outgoing calls to schedule patient exams when receiving scripts and electronic orders.
  • Answer incoming and place outgoing calls in a courteous and professional manner—identifies self and company.
  • The ability to handle interactions with a high degree of empathy and emotional intelligence.
  • Strong rapport building capabilities.
  • Keen eye for details with good probing and understanding skills.
  • Strong interpersonal skills with heavy focus on customer satisfaction and service.
  • Ability to de-escalate and recover difficult interactions.
  • Handle VIP Physician scheduling requests through phone call, and/or chat.
  • Place calls to referring physicians for patients expressing difficulty with scheduling.
  • Maintain self-control when dealing with difficult patients and or situations.
  • Show care and compassion for all callers.
  • Maintain good rapport with referring physicians, secretaries and clinical site staff.
  • Enter accurate information in RIS for appointment scheduling, rescheduling, cancellation and comment entry.
  • Update account information at the point of scheduling.
  • Properly schedule all procedures.
  • Utilize RIS filter screens to answer questions associated with insurance, procedures and preps.
  • Communicate and interact with all departments effectively and professionally.
  • Maintain professionalism with both internal and external customers.
  • Meet incoming call volume quota.
  • Fax reports as needed. 

 

Qualifications:

Our most successful candidates will have: ·        

  • Must be 18 years or older.
  •  A minimum of 3-4 CXC/GCE/City & Guilds subjects inclusive of English Language, or a U.S. high school diploma or GED. CXC/CSEC, City & Guilds. I, II, III; GCE A, B, C; SSC 4, 5; JSCE Pass; NCTVET or HEART Level 1, 2, 3; and CCSLC - Competence & Mastery. ( Must have proof of qualifications)
  • Prior Healthcare/Insurance experience preferred.
  • 2 years of BPO/Customer Service experience preferred.
  • Must have a valid (not expired) government issued ID, TRN and NIS card.
  • Must be able to pass a criminal background check and drug test as needed.
  • Must have flexible availability to work any day and any assigned shift weekly.(Weekends and Public Holidays).
  • Must be able to train and / or work onsite at our Red Hills Road site.
  •  
  • Demonstrated ability to perform at a high level, to support our high volume of inbound calls.
  • Experience in customer service is an asset and preferred.
  • Good systematic problem solving ability , using sound business judgment, and following through on commitments to customers.
  • The ability to quickly and accurately identify and assess individual customer needs and take appropriate action steps to satisfy those needs.
  • Excellent attention to detail.
  • A passion for helping customers and exceeding their expectations with high integrity.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills and the ability to tailor styles to the audience
  • See through the eyes of the customer.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills; able to translate Customer communication rapidly and effectively on live voice or chat interactions. proficient reading skills required.
  • The ability to project patience, empathy, caring, and sincerity in written words or voice tone, depending on channel.
  • Ability to effectively organize, prioritize, multi-task and manage time.
  • Multi-tasking skills, showcased through the use of several applications; experience working with CRM applications preferred.
  • Basic PC keyboarding skills; basic Microsoft Office (Outlook, Word, Excel) experience required.
  • Ability to type over 30 WPM with 80% accuracy.
  • Must be very tech savvy with strong abilities in handling troubleshooting techniques and resolving technical issues.
  • Inspire confidence and positively influence the behaviour, actions, and thoughts of others.

Additional Information:

Our employees enjoy:

  • Competitive compensation packages inclusive of base pay, incentives, over-time and shift differentials for certain shifts.
  • Annual merit increase based on performance.
  • Paid Training.
  • Discounts for several corporate and retail partners for services and products once Sutherland ID is presented.
  • Excellent training and supervisory support - to help you feel comfortable servicing our customers.
  • Competitive Salary with attractive and attainable PBI structure.
  • Paid vacation and sick leave annually.
  • Exceptional Health and Life Insurance Plan
  • Onsite cafeteria.
  • Onsite lunch concessionaire at reduced rates.
  • Transportation/ Shuttle Services - Free transportation home for shifts that end after 9:00 pm and pick-ups for shifts that begin before 6am
  • Free On-site medical suite with nurse and medical doctor.
  • Daily Refuel Plan - Robust and dynamic schedule of activities to keep employees energized both at home and in the office.
  • Paid referral program
  • Career development & growth opportunities for advancement.
  • Excellent Reward and recognition programs.

Job Description:

Job Summary

The Subject Matter Expert (SME) serves as the clinical and operational resource for the AO Clinical Claims Program. This role provides expertise on clinical claims processes, medical documentation review, disability management guidelines, quality standards, and client-specific policies and procedures. The SME supports production teams through coaching, training, case consultations, quality improvement initiatives, and process governance to ensure service excellence, compliance, and operational efficiency.

This is a dual-role position that requires the incumbent to function both as a Clinical Claims Associate and as a Subject Matter Expert simultaneously. In addition to providing expert guidance, floor support, coaching, and process expertise, the SME is expected to independently perform the same core clinical claims review and case management responsibilities as other team members. The SME will maintain an assigned production workload and is expected to meet established productivity, quality, accuracy, and compliance metrics while providing real-time support to the operations team.

The ideal candidate is a licensed US Registered Nurse (USRN) with strong clinical claims experience, exceptional analytical skills, and the ability to collaborate effectively with operations leaders, quality teams, trainers, and client stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities

Clinical and Operational Expertise

  • Serve as the primary clinical subject matter expert for disability and clinical claims operations.
  • Interpret and apply client-specific guidelines, medical policies, and standard operating procedures.
  • Review complex cases and provide recommendations to associates and leadership teams.
  • Support accurate evaluation and documentation of clinical claims based on medical evidence and established protocols.
  • Ensure consistency in claims handling and decision-support processes.
  • Perform end-to-end clinical claims review, assessment, and documentation activities consistent with the responsibilities of a Clinical Claims Associate/Analyst.
  • Maintain an assigned production workload and achieve established productivity, quality, accuracy, and compliance targets.
  • Balance individual case processing responsibilities with SME support, coaching, and escalation management activities.
  • Demonstrate best practices in claims handling, clinical documentation review, and decision-making while serving as a role model for the team.

Team Support and Coaching

  • Provide floor support and real-time assistance to agents and analysts.
  • Conduct case reviews, side-by-side coaching, and knowledge-sharing sessions.
  • Identify performance gaps and recommend developmental interventions.
  • Act as the escalation point for process-related and clinical questions.
  • Provide support to associates while actively managing a personal caseload and production responsibilities.
  • Serve as a role model by demonstrating effective claims processing techniques, adherence to operational standards, and strong performance outcomes.

Training and Knowledge Management

  • Facilitate refresher sessions and uptraining programs.
  • Assist Training and Operations teams in creating and updating process documentation.
  • Support onboarding activities for new hires.
  • Maintain knowledge repositories and ensure process updates are communicated effectively.

Quality and Compliance

  • Partner with Quality Assurance teams to drive accuracy and compliance metrics.
  • Participate in calibration sessions to ensure consistent interpretation of clinical policies.
  • Monitor regulatory and client-driven changes impacting operations.
  • Support audit activities and corrective action plans.
  • Lead by example by consistently meeting quality and compliance standards in both production and SME-related responsibilities.

Process Improvement

  • Identify opportunities to improve workflow efficiency and claim review processes.
  • Analyze trends, defects, and operational challenges.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders on continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Assist in implementing process enhancements and best practices.

Stakeholder Management

  • Work closely with Operations Managers, Team Managers, Quality Analysts, Trainers, Workforce, and Client Partners.
  • Participate in client meetings and discussions when requested.
  • Provide insights and recommendations based on operational and clinical findings.

Qualifications:

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • Active and unrestricted US Registered Nurse (USRN) license.
  • Bachelor's Degree in Nursing (BSN).
  • Minimum 2-3 years of US healthcare experience in one or a combination of the following:
    • Disability Claims
    • Clinical Claims Review
    • Utilization Management (UM)
    • Case Management (CM)
    • Workers' Compensation
    • Medical Review
    • Insurance Claims Operations
  • Extensive knowledge of medical terminology, disease processes, treatment protocols, and clinical documentation review.
  • Strong understanding of disability management and insurance claims processes.
  • Experience working in a healthcare BPO/shared services environment preferred.
  • Strong analytical and critical-thinking skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and Outlook.
  • Willing to work in a shifting schedule and support business requirements.
  • Demonstrated ability to effectively balance individual production responsibilities with Subject Matter Expert support functions.
  • Proven experience maintaining performance metrics while providing coaching, floor support, guidance, and operational assistance to peers.
  • Strong time management, prioritization, multitasking, and stakeholder management skills in a fast-paced clinical operations environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting Disability Claims, Group Benefits, or similar insurance accounts.
  • Lean Six Sigma or Continuous Improvement exposure.
  • Experience facilitating training and coaching sessions.
  • Background in quality auditing and process calibration.
  • Leadership or project management experience.

Additional Information:

Internal Qualifications:

  • Must have Annual PDP score of Exceeds Expectations (4) or Outstanding (5)
  • Tenure of at least 12 months on the current role
  • No Active DA 

Role Clarification

Important: This is not a dedicated support-only SME position. The selected candidate will be expected to perform the same core clinical claims processing and case review functions as other team members while simultaneously serving as the team's Subject Matter Expert. Success in this role requires balancing production targets, quality expectations, coaching responsibilities, escalation support, and operational excellence.

Job Description:

Key Responsibilities

  • Review 1003/URLA and supporting loan documents.
  • Analyze income, employment, assets, liabilities, credit and REO.
  • Review Non-QM / DSCR loan scenarios.
  • Validate bank statements, large deposits and source of funds.
  • Review appraisal, property, occupancy and LTV/CLTV.
  • Identify discrepancies across 1003, credit and supporting documents.
  • Make independent underwriting decisions based on applicable guidelines.
     

    SCOPE OF WORK FOR LIVE UNDERWRITER ROLE

    • Loan Application Review & Credit Assessment:
    Review and analyze loan applications and supporting documentation including income, credit reports, employment history, and property details. Assess borrower creditworthiness using the 4 C’s methodology (Character, Capacity, Capital, Collateral) to ensure sound lending decisions.

    • Income Calculation & Financial Analysis:
    Evaluate and calculate borrower income from various sources including salaried, hourly, commission, bonus, rental, and self-employment income. Analyze documents such as paystubs, W-2s, tax returns, and business financials (Schedule C, K-1, 1065, 1120S) to determine qualifying income accurately.

    • Collateral & Property Evaluation:
    Review appraisal reports, AVMs, and residential valuation documents to validate property value and ensure compliance with lending guidelines. Analyze title reports, lien positions, and ownership details.

    • Underwriting Decision & Documentation:
    Prepare detailed underwriting summaries, identify red flags, and document conditions and stipulations within the Loan Origination System (LOS), preferably Encompass. Recommend appropriate loan structures based on risk assessment.

    • Workflow Management & Communication:
    Collaborate with processors and internal stakeholders throughout the underwriting lifecycle. Provide clear communication on loan decisions, required conditions, and final clear-to-close (CTC) status.

    • Risk Identification & Compliance:
    Identify discrepancies, inconsistencies, and potential risks in loan files. Ensure all underwriting decisions comply with internal policies and regulatory requirements.

    • Reporting & Reconciliation:
    Handle reconciliation of complex borrower accounts and prepare daily aging and pipeline reports to track loan progress and turnaround times.

    • System Utilization & Process Adherence:
    Utilize LOS platforms (Encompass preferred) and adhere to underwriting workflows, ensuring accuracy, efficiency, and compliance with company standards.

Qualifications:

Mandatory Skills

  • US Residential Mortgage Live Underwriting experience - 2 years and above
  • Strong knowledge of 1003/URLA documentation
  • Experience with DU/AUS
  • Strong income, credit, asset and liability analysis
  • Non-QM / DSCR experience preferred
  • HSC or Graduate passouts can apply for the job

Additional Information:

JOB DETAILS

  • Company: Sutherland Mortgage Services
  • Location: Navi Mumbai (Work From Office)
  • Experience: 2–3 Years (Live Underwriting Mandatory)
  • Shift: US Shift (Any 9 Hours of shift)
  • Week Offs: 2 Week offs
  • Employment Type: Full-Time
  • Mediclaim and Insurance benefits along with travel allowance.

job.title: Technical Support Agent (TSA) - Tier 1 SPA
job.description:
Descripción del empleo:

Job Description

The Technical Support Agent provides frontline technical support and customer service across multiple channels, including phone, email, chat, e-ticketing, and other approved Lenovo support platforms. The role is responsible for capturing customer information, validating warranty entitlement, diagnosing and resolving technical issues, managing customer inquiries, documenting interactions, and ensuring a positive customer experience throughout the support lifecycle.

The Technical Support Agent serves as the first point of contact for customers, using approved troubleshooting methodologies and Lenovo support processes to resolve issues efficiently while maintaining service quality, compliance, and customer satisfaction standards. The role also supports High Priority Support activities, including proactive follow-ups, scheduled callbacks, unresolved case management, and escalation coordination to ensure customer issues are addressed through completion.

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide technical support and customer service through inbound calls, outbound calls, email, chat, e-ticketing, and other approved support channels.
  • Capture and validate customer information, product details, warranty entitlement, and case data accurately.
  • Review customer history and previous interactions to support effective issue resolution.
  • Diagnose, troubleshoot, and resolve customer-reported hardware, software, networking, and system issues using approved Lenovo workflows and tools.
  • Apply logical troubleshooting techniques to identify root causes and determine appropriate resolution paths.
  • Manage customer case status requests and provide accurate updates and next steps.
  • Perform proactive follow-up callbacks for unresolved, interrupted, disconnected, incomplete, or appointment-based support interactions.
  • Escalate issues to Level 1.5 Technical Support Specialists or other support teams when additional technical expertise is required.
  • Maintain ownership of assigned cases and ensure proper follow-through until resolution, closure, or formal handoff.
  • Document customer interactions, troubleshooting activities, resolutions, and escalation actions accurately within approved systems.
  • Protect customer privacy and follow all Lenovo policies regarding data protection, information security, and compliance.
  • Meet operational performance standards related to quality, productivity, customer satisfaction, attendance, and service levels.

Requisitos:

Education

  • High School Diploma required.
  • Technical Vocational Course in Computer Maintenance and Repair, Information Technology, Systems Support, or equivalent required.
  • College degree preferred.

Experience

  • Minimum one (1) year of experience in a technical support, help desk, service desk, IT support, or customer-facing technical support role.
  • Experience supporting customers in a customer-facing environment required.
  • Experience supporting customers through multiple channels such as voice, email, chat, e-ticketing, or online support tools preferred.
  • Knowledge of PC hardware, software, and technology industry products preferred.

Knowledge & Technical Skills

  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
  • Knowledge of Windows 10 and Windows 11 operating systems.
  • Understanding of Microsoft 365 applications and user-level troubleshooting.
  • Knowledge of PC hardware, laptops, desktops, workstations, docking stations, peripherals, and related technologies.
  • Familiarity with Device Manager, drivers, BIOS/UEFI, firmware updates, and Lenovo diagnostic tools.
  • Understanding of storage devices, SSDs, disk management, and data transfer concepts.
  • Knowledge of Wi-Fi, Ethernet, Bluetooth, VPN, TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, and basic networking concepts.
  • Familiarity with remote support tools, CRM systems, ticketing platforms, and knowledge base tools.
  • Ability to work effectively in a multi-system technical support environment.
  • Strong documentation and case management skills.
  • Typing speed of at least 35 WPM required.
  • Typing speed of at least 45 WPM and 90% accuracy required for email, chat, and digital support positions.

Communication & Customer Service Skills

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Strong active listening and customer empathy.
  • Ability to communicate technical information clearly to non-technical users.
  • Strong customer ownership and follow-through mindset.
  • Ability to manage difficult customer situations professionally and effectively.
  • Ability to multitask across multiple channels while maintaining quality and accuracy.

Language Requirements

Spanish Support Positions

  • Spanish: Native or Near-Native (Required)
  • English: Basic (A2) or Higher (Required)

Core Competencies

  • Technical Troubleshooting
  • Customer Service Excellence
  • Multi-Channel Support
  • Warranty Validation
  • Case Management & Documentation
  • Problem Solving & Critical Thinking
  • Escalation Management
  • Technical Communication
  • Customer Ownership
  • Adaptability & Learning Agility
  • Attention to Detail
  • Time Management & Multitasking
  • Customer Privacy & Data Protection Compliance
  • Continuous Improvement Mindset

job.title: Social Media Customer Support Consultant (SMCSC)
job.description:
Descripción del empleo:

Job Description

The Social Media Customer Support Consultant (SMCSC) is responsible for providing customer support and issue resolution through social media, online communities, review sites, forums, blogs, and other digital engagement platforms. The role acts as a frontline brand representative, delivering personalized, empathetic, and professional responses while protecting the customer experience and Lenovo brand reputation.

The SMCSC serves as a digital customer advocate by identifying the most appropriate support path based on customer needs, product eligibility, and service requirements. The role also supports trend identification, Voice of the Customer initiatives, escalation management, sentiment monitoring, and continuous improvement efforts across customer experience channels.

This position requires excellent written communication skills, strong social media awareness, sound judgment, technical aptitude, customer advocacy, and the ability to navigate sensitive or public customer interactions professionally.

Key Responsibilities

  • Respond to customer inquiries, issues, complaints, and service requests through social media, online communities, review sites, forums, blogs, and other digital channels.
  • Provide personalized, brand-aligned, and customer-focused responses in both public and private interactions.
  • Guide customers to the appropriate support path based on issue type, product, entitlement status, and available service options.
  • Troubleshoot customer concerns within approved support boundaries and escalate when additional assistance is required.
  • Identify trending issues, recurring complaints, customer sentiment shifts, and potential service-impacting events.
  • Escalate urgent, high-risk, sensitive, or brand-impacting situations according to established procedures.
  • Research customer history, support documentation, and knowledge content to provide accurate and consistent responses.
  • Support Voice of the Customer initiatives by identifying recurring customer pain points, feedback trends, and improvement opportunities.
  • Maintain professional tone, messaging consistency, and brand standards across all supported digital channels.
  • Protect customer privacy and ensure compliance with social media governance, security, and data protection policies.
  • Support moderation activities and monitor digital channels for inappropriate content, abuse, or policy violations when applicable.
  • Provide feedback and recommendations to improve customer communications, support content, processes, and customer experience outcomes.

Requisitos:

Qualifications

Education

  • High School Diploma required.
  • College coursework or degree in Communications, Marketing, Business Administration, Customer Experience, Information Technology, or related fields preferred.

Experience

  • Minimum 1-2 years of experience in customer service, technical support, social media support, digital engagement, online communities, or contact center operations.
  • Experience supporting customers through social media platforms, digital channels, or public-facing customer service environments preferred.
  • Technical support experience, customer experience management, or brand engagement experience preferred.
  • Experience working in SLA-driven customer support environments preferred.

Knowledge & Skills

  • Strong understanding of social media and digital customer care platforms including Facebook, Instagram, X (Twitter), YouTube, LinkedIn, TikTok, online communities, forums, blogs, review sites, and complaint platforms.
  • Ability to troubleshoot basic technical issues and explain solutions in a customer-friendly manner.
  • Familiarity with CRM systems, ticketing platforms, knowledge bases, and digital engagement tools.
  • Ability to research support content, customer history, and operational information to provide accurate responses.
  • Knowledge of Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, modern web browsers, and commonly used customer applications preferred.
  • Strong understanding of customer experience principles, digital engagement, and brand reputation management.
  • Ability to analyze customer feedback, identify trends, and provide recommendations for improvement.
  • Understanding of privacy requirements, social media governance, content moderation, and customer data protection practices.

Communication Skills

  • Excellent written communication skills with exceptional grammar, spelling, punctuation, and attention to detail.
  • Ability to communicate clearly, professionally, empathetically, and concisely across multiple digital channels.
  • Ability to adapt communication style based on platform, audience, sentiment, and business requirements.
  • Strong reading comprehension and ability to interpret customer intent, tone, and context accurately.
  • Ability to communicate without relying on scripted responses while maintaining consistency and brand standards.
  • Strong customer advocacy, diplomacy, and conflict management skills.

Language Requirements

  • Spanish: Native or Near-Native (Required)
  • English: Basic (A2) or Higher (Required)

Core Competencies

  • Social Media Customer Support
  • Customer Advocacy
  • Digital Communication
  • Brand Representation
  • Online Reputation Management
  • Social Media Engagement
  • Customer Experience Management
  • Problem Solving & Decision Making
  • Trend & Sentiment Analysis
  • Voice of the Customer Awareness
  • Escalation Management
  • Data Privacy & Compliance
  • Adaptability & Learning Agility
  • Attention to Detail
  • Professional Written Communication
  • Continuous Improvement Mindset

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience using social listening, community management, moderation, or customer engagement platforms.

job.title: Retail Customer Service Associate - Contract Opportunity
job.description:
Company Description:

Sutherland is looking for a self-motivated, team-oriented and career-oriented person to join us as a Retail Customer Service Associate to serve customers in the United States. We are a group of driven and hard-working individuals. If you are looking to build a fulfilling career and are confident you have the skills and experience to help us succeed, we want to work with you! 

We are a group of driven and hard-working individuals. If you are looking to build a fulfilling career and are confident you have the skills and experience to help us succeed, we want to work with you!  

Job Description:

Large e-Commerce Furniture Marketplace seeking Customer Service Associate Professionals to join our team. Candidate will act as a liaison, provide services information, answer questions, and resolve any emerging problems that our clients' accounts might face with accuracy and efficiency. Candidate should be genuinely excited to help clients. You must be patient, empathetic, and passionately communicative. The target is to ensure excellent service standards, respond efficiently to clients inquiries and maintain high customer satisfaction. These customers are based in North America.

Responsibilities

  • Identify and assess clients’ needs to achieve satisfaction
  • Build sustainable relationships and trust with customer accounts through open and interactive communication
  • Provide accurate, valid and complete information by using the right methods/tools
  • Meet personal/customer service team sales targets and call handling quotas
  • Handle customer complaints, provide appropriate solutions and alternatives within the time limits; follow up to ensure resolution
  • Keep records of customer interactions, process customer accounts and file documents
  • Follow communication procedures, guidelines and policies
  • Take the extra mile to engage clients

What Does Service Representative Do?

  • Demonstrate Reliability: Attendance and commitment to being present and on time for your full shift each day is crucial. This helps ensure we're ready and available to help our customers when they need us most. For unexpected events or issues, we require our representatives to be proactive in their communication and planning whenever possible.
  • Handle a High Volume of Contacts: You will handle an estimated 50-60 emails, chat, SMS per shift. This is a fast paced environment and highly structured. There is little down time in this position as you are typically on back to back chats during your shift.
  • Meet Our High Performance Bar: You’ll work to exceed customer satisfaction, excel in meeting customer service efficiency metrics, and other responsibilities as assigned. 
  • Engage Customers: You’ll need a passion for people. You'll be the voice of Wayfair and work to build a relationship with customers who contact us by inbound phone call, chats, and emails. Topics can range from returns, replacements, delivery, product availability, order status, and more. 
  • Listen Actively and Show Empathy: You will actively listen to understand customer concerns and leverage internal resources to find the best solution to thoroughly address their problem.
  • De-Escalate Customer Concerns: Most customers contact us because they’ve had a problem and need your help. You will use your conflict management skills to balance the needs of the customer with the options from the business while always maintaining a professional composure.
  • Problem Solve: Solutions aren’t a one-size-fits-all approach so customer service representatives do not read from pre-populated scripts. You will be given a level of autonomy to help customers find the right solution. You’ll need to think analytically to solve customer problems in a first contact resolution approach.
  • Multitask: You’ll need to juggle navigating multiple browsers, tabs, tools, and screens in order to quickly and effectively answer questions. The ideal customer service representative will be familiar with computers and can effectively navigate technology on a daily basis.
  • Escalate Systemic Issues: Help us continuously improve. You’ll identify areas where improvement is needed on behalf of Wayfair customers and share any trends with leadership.

Qualifications:

Our most successful candidates will have :

  • Must be at least 18 years or older.
  • We require all candidates to have a minimum of 3 subjects inclusive of English (CXC/CSEC, City & Guilds. I, II, III; GCE A, B, C; SSC 4, 5; JSCE Pass; NCTVET Level 1, 2, 3; and CCSLC Competence & Mastery) OR or a U.S. high school diploma or GED. 
  • Must be able to pass a criminal background check.
  • Must have flexible availability to work any day and any assigned shift weekly.(Weekends and Public Holidays).
  • Must successfully pass English Language written assessments.
  • Consistency in performance and an "I can and will win attitude".
  • Demonstrated ability to perform at a high level, to support our high volume of inbound calls.
  • Experience in customer service is an asset and preferred.
  • Good systematic problem solving ability , using sound business judgment, and following through on commitments to customers.
  • The ability to quickly and accurately identify and assess individual customer needs and take appropriate action steps to satisfy those needs.
  • Excellent attention to detail.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills; able to translate Customer communication rapidly and effectively on live voice or chat interactions. proficient reading skills required.
  • The ability to project patience, empathy, caring, and sincerity in written words or voice tone, depending on channel.
  • Ability to effectively organize, prioritize, multi-task and manage time.
  • Multi-tasking skills, showcased through the use of several applications; experience working with CRM applications preferred.
  • Basic PC keyboarding skills; basic Microsoft Office (Outlook, Word, Excel) experience required.
  • Must have basic computer skills with the ability to navigate and manipulate a computer system.
  • Must be very tech savvy with strong abilities in handling troubleshooting techniques and resolving technical issues.
  • Inspire confidence and positively influence the behaviour, actions, and thoughts of others.
  • No commitments that will impact your ability to commit to work for the next 18 – 24 months

Additional Information:

Our employees enjoy:

  • Competitive compensation packages inclusive of base pay, incentives, over-time and shift differentials for certain shifts.
  • Annual merit increase based on performance.
  • Paid Training.
  • Discounts for several corporate and retail partners for services and products once Sutherland ID is presented.
  • Excellent training and supervisory support - to help you feel comfortable servicing our customers.
  • Competitive Salary with attractive and attainable PBI structure.
  • Paid vacation and sick leave annually.
  • Exceptional Health and Life Insurance Plan
  • Lunch benefits and subsidy.
  • Onsite lunch concessionaire at reduced rates.
  • Transportation/ Shuttle Services - Free transportation home for shifts that end after 9:00 pm and pick-ups for shifts that begin before 6am
  • Free On-site medical suite with nurse and medical doctor.
  • Daily Refuel Plan - Robust and dynamic schedule of activities to keep employees energized both at home and in the office.
  • Paid referral program
  • Career development & growth opportunities for advancement.
  • Excellent Reward and recognition programs.

As your prospective employer, we need to process your Personal Data as needed to evaluate your qualification for the position you are applying for with Sutherland.  During the recruitment process, your Personal Data may be transferred outside of Jamaica and disclosed to third parties in the normal course of the recruitment and/or employment process or as needed to comply with applicable laws. This may include transferring information to our affiliated Companies for purposes connected to your employment with the company or to the management of Sutherland’s business.
